Everything excellent

Unfortunately, I can't give 0 stars, otherwise I would. If you take your pet's bed to be cleaned, the condition of the washing machine will be like this, but don't worry, there will be a gentleman at the cash register ready to tell you that "all the dirt you see in the middle of the bed won't go in" (it doesn't really work that way) and his colleague will try to make you believe that's the case because "10 people were here today" (this is months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months and months, if not more, I think it's obvious). Zero professionalism, politeness and empathy, let's not even talk about it, the lady uses problem solving by turning around and walking away while you talk to her. I asked for a refund, not for the amount because, at least, that is low, but out of principle and for how we were treated. What can I say, highly discouraged.
For me, crossing the threshold of my favorite Arcaplanet store means finding a little piece of my life spent with my furry friends...past (but always in my heart) and present. What more can I say?
Nothing to envy from other shops

The staff are always super friendly, welcoming, and ready to answer questions with expertise and professionalism. It's now my go-to store (which, with three cats and a dog, I frequent quite often), even though there's another store near my house (on Via Franco Angeli), where I've been a few times, and on two occasions they were quite rude and impertinent.

I usually go to the one in the pine forest, but this one is much better stocked.
There's also a lot of choice for rabbits.

At first, it felt like the Wild West because I couldn't see anyone to ask in the aisle, but then, when I got to the checkout, a whole new world opened up to me. The cashier, incredibly kind, gave us all the information no one else at Arcaplanet had ever given us. Plus, our cats happily eat their products where, I repeat, no one had shown them to us. For this customer service, they've earned two loyal fans. Thank you so much 😘😘😘
Well stocked and very kind staff.

I booked the place to wash my dog.
The place has everything you need to wash your dog, plus you can buy shampoo from them at a very low price.
The only downside, but it's understandable, is the smell inside the place.
Otherwise, it's very convenient and practical.
The least well-stocked of all the Arcaplanet stores and unfortunately among those with the least helpful and customer-focused staff.
My go-to shop for my poodle. The shop has a large selection but is a bit pricey, like the rest of the chain.
Everything is complete.
Well-stocked shop and excellent self-service toilet service.
A little out of the way but easy to reach, well stocked and with a variety of offers for our friends.
Lots of choice, high prices, and practically unusable spots. For dog washing, excellent and highly recommended.
I am a regular customer, everyone is kind and helpful with advice if needed
Kindness and courtesy. Clean and up-to-date store with Royal Canin dry and wet food.
The shop is well stocked and tidy but the prices are a bit high.

I often take my dogs to Pet Wash and I love it!
The stalls are always clean and smell good, and the staff at the store are very helpful.
They also have washing machines for our four-legged friends' accessories!

Of course, to use the service, you must book online and pay directly at the cashier upon arrival.

I'll keep coming back :)

One of the few places available for a REAL dog wash.
Hot water, liquid vacuuming, and drying are available.
Shampoo can be brought from home or purchased in-store.
Reservation required. My only personal recommendation to customers: leave the dog wash as clean as possible after use, although the washes are sanitized by staff before each use.
An excellent solution for those who prefer to do it themselves with their dog.

The store is poorly stocked with other brands like Exclusion or Monge, but it does have four shelves of their own brand.
The staff is unhelpful, unsympathetic, and uninterested in customer service.
I would have given a 0, but it wasn't possible.
